sentences.en: After work, I visit a little bookshop.
sentences.zh: 下班后，我去逛一家小书店。
sentences.ipa: /ˈæf.tɚ wɝːk aɪ ˈvɪz.ɪt ə ˈlɪt.əl ˈbʊk.ʃɑːp/

sentences.en: It is on a quiet corner near my home.
sentences.zh: 书店在我家附近一个安静的街角。
sentences.ipa: /ɪt ɪz ɑːn ə ˈkwaɪ.ət ˈkɔːr.nɚ nɪr maɪ hoʊm/

sentences.en: A kind woman smiles and says hello.
sentences.zh: 一位和善的女士微笑着向我问好。
sentences.ipa: /ə kaɪnd ˈwʊm.ən smaɪlz ənd sez həˈloʊ/

sentences.en: I find a small book on a low shelf.
sentences.zh: 我在低处的书架上找到一本小书。
sentences.ipa: /aɪ faɪnd ə smɑːl bʊk ɑːn ə loʊ ʃelf/

sentences.en: The story is about a dog and a boy.
sentences.zh: 这个故事讲的是一只狗和一个男孩。
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈstɔːr.i ɪz əˈbaʊt ə dɑːɡ ənd ə bɔɪ/

sentences.en: I sit by the window and read a page.
sentences.ipa: /aɪ sɪt baɪ ðə ˈwɪn.doʊ ənd riːd ə peɪdʒ/

sentences.en: Outside, people walk home in the light rain.
sentences.zh: 窗外，人们冒着小雨步行回家。
sentences.ipa: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈpiː.pəl wɑːk hoʊm ɪn ðə laɪt reɪn/

sentences.en: The woman brings me a cup of warm tea.
sentences.zh: 那位女士给我端来一杯温热的茶。
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈwʊm.ən brɪŋz miː ə kʌp əv wɔːrm tiː/

sentences.en: I buy the book and thank her.
sentences.zh: 我买下这本书，并向她道谢。
sentences.ipa: /aɪ baɪ ðə bʊk ənd θæŋk hɚ/

sentences.en: At home, I read another page before bed.
sentences.zh: 回到家，我在睡前再读一页书。
sentences.ipa: /ət hoʊm aɪ riːd əˈnʌð.ɚ peɪdʒ bɪˈfɔːr bed/
